policy: Legacy identifiers are compatibility handles only. New branding, schemas, artifacts, and newly created resources must use MUSITU. A legacy live handle may be retired only after its MUSITU successor is created, verified, cut over, and rollback evidence is sealed.

resources.cutover_gate: repository rename or migration preserves commit history, Actions secrets, workflows, and all external references
a MUSITU-branded apex domain is owned, Cloudflare-protected, and verified before DNS/API migration
FULL health, 74 operations, unauthenticated 401, authenticated compute 42, signed receipt, D1 persistence, rollback
canonical six-table schema, indexes, row reconciliation, write/readback, rollback
all workflows and active bindings point to successor
exact FULL build identity, root-package pins, 74 operations, authenticated-only endpoint
exact FULL build identity and canonical /v1/compute route verified
canonical Worker accepts successor and legacy only during bounded transition, then legacy removed
HMAC receipt validation passes on successor binding and legacy binding is retired
all trusted clients and Worker source accept successor; legacy header then rejected
request tracing remains deterministic through Worker, adapter, Modal, and receipts
version negotiation passes existing contract suite
internal admin/control authorization remains fail-closed under successor principal
all workflow evidence producers and consumers agree on successor symbol

immutable_evidence_policy.build_ids: Historical build IDs beginning with the retired namespace remain immutable evidence and are never rewritten retroactively.
immutable_evidence_policy.sealed_hashes: Cryptographic hashes, signed receipts, archived evidence, and historical artifact identities are never renamed in place.
